TOKEN-IMAGES.name: Token Image Search
TOKEN-IMAGES.label: Configure Token Images
TOKEN-IMAGES.hint: Quickly search and change token art from the Token HUD.
TOKEN-IMAGES.enable-hud-hint: Adds a button to the Token HUD (GM only) to search and swap token art.
TOKEN-IMAGES.fuzzy-hint: 0 = exact match only, 1 = match almost anything. Default 0.3.
TOKEN-IMAGES.result-limit-hint: Maximum number of images shown in the HUD search.
TOKEN-IMAGES.use-dig-down-hint: Use the search index from the "Dig Down – Advanced Search" module for far faster image searching. Recommended for >1,000 images.
TOKEN-IMAGES.search-portraits: Search portrait / sheet image folders instead
TOKEN-IMAGES.refresh: Refresh image list (pick up newly added art)
TOKEN-IMAGES.no-paths: No search folder is set for {kind} yet.
TOKEN-IMAGES.no-paths-warning: Token Image Search has no folder to search for {kind}. Set one in Image Folders.
TOKEN-IMAGES.apply-error: Failed to update token image — see console.
SIDEBAR-TABS.name: Sidebar Tabs
SIDEBAR-TABS.label: Configure Sidebar Tabs
SIDEBAR-TABS.hint: Show, hide, or reorder tabs in the right sidebar.
SIDEBAR-TABS.dialog-hint: Unchecked tabs are hidden from your sidebar. Drag the grip to reorder them. The Settings tab can't be hidden or moved.
SIDEBAR-TABS.dialog-hint-gm: Configure the right sidebar tabs for everyone. Uncheck to hide, drag to reorder. Players can still change their own. The Settings tab can't be hidden or moved.
SIDEBAR-TWEAKS.name: Sidebar Tweaks
SIDEBAR-TWEAKS.label: Configure Sidebar Tweaks
SIDEBAR-TWEAKS.hint: Configure extras and settings for features in the right sidebar, like group rolls and the placeables tab.
SCENE-CONTROLS.name: Scene Controls
SCENE-CONTROLS.label: Configure Scene Controls
SCENE-CONTROLS.hint: Show, hide, or reorder the top-level buttons in the scene controls on the left side of the screen.
SCENE-CONTROLS.dialog-hint: Unchecked buttons are hidden from your scene controls. Drag the grip to reorder them. Token Controls can't be hidden or moved.
SCENE-CONTROLS.dialog-hint-gm: Override the default scene controls on the left side of the screen. Uncheck to hide, or drag to reorder. Players can still change their own.
LANDING.name: Landing Page
LANDING.label: Configure Landing Page
LANDING.hint: Rotate the background of the login screen players see before joining.
LANDING.lp-enabled-hint: Picks a new login screen background from images selected below, refreshed each time the world loads.
LANDING.image-folder-hint: Background images are loaded from and uploaded to this folder.
LANDING.images-empty: No images found in this folder.
LANDING.no-images: Tick at least one background image first.
LANDING.publish-failed: Could not update the landing page background: {error}
FONTS.name: Fonts
FONTS.label: Configure Fonts
FONTS.hint: Font files from a folder, for character names (Tidy sheet header, owned item titles and token nameplate) and the pause text.
FONTS.folder-hint: Supports .woff2, .woff, .ttf and .otf files. Each file is treated as a separate font.
FONTS.files-empty: No font files found in this folder.
FONTS.column-custom-hint: Offered in this module's pickers below.
FONTS.column-core-hint: In Foundry's own font list, for text editors, drawings and map notes.
FONTS.files-hint: A font in Foundry's list loads once, through Foundry. Changes to that list reach other players after a reload.
FONTS.characters-hint: Choose a font to customize a PC's sheet header (Tidy Sheets only), the titles of items they own, and their token's nameplate on the canvas.
FONTS.characters-empty: No player character actors in this world.
FONTS.x-card-hint: X-Card cycles through the fonts ticked here. With none ticked, it shows the default X image.
FONTS.reset-confirm: Reset the font folder, turn every font back on, and clear the default, character, pause and X-Card fonts?
ACTIVITY-DEFAULTS.template-unchecked-hin: When using an item or spell, the "Place Measured Template" box starts unchecked. Players can still tick it.
GROUP-ROLLS.enabled-hint: Adds Roll NPC and Roll All buttons to group roll cards. Right-click an actor row to reset, reroll with advantage or disadvantage, or remove from the roll.
GROUP-ROLLS.roll-npc-hint: Roll for every NPC that hasn't rolled yet
GROUP-ROLLS.roll-all-hint: Roll for everyone you control who hasn't rolled yet
GROUP-ROLLS.no-gm: A GM needs to be online for rolls to show on the card.
PLACEABLES-TAB.center-hint: Click an entry in the Placeables sidebar tab to the canvas on it. This conflicts with double-click to open, which will always zoom to the entry.
PLACEABLES-TAB.middle-click-hint: Middle-click an entry in the Placeables sidebar tab to open its sheet.
X-CARD.enabled-hint: Adds an X-Card button to the scene controls on the left. Pressing it shows a giant X on every screen without saying who pressed it. Pick its fonts in Configure Fonts. The X-Card is by John Stavropoulos (tinyurl.com/x-card-rpg).
X-CARD.title: X-Card
SETTINGS-PANE.title: Module Settings
SETTINGS-PANE.edit: Edit modules: show switches and disabled modules
SETTINGS-PANE.missing-deps: Can't enable {name}. It requires {ids}, which isn't installed.
PLAYER-FOLDERS.name: Image Folders
PLAYER-FOLDERS.label: Configure Player Image Folders
PLAYER-FOLDERS.hint: Set the image folders you and your players can browse and upload images to.
PLAYER-FOLDERS.unset-warning: Without image folders set, token image search won't work.
PLAYER-FOLDERS.dialog-hint: Players can choose images from the "Browse" folder. Their uploads go to the "Upload" folder. These settings set the default folder for GMs.
PLAYER-FOLDERS.recommended-confirm: Replace every folder in this dialog with the recommended layout under assets/? Nothing is saved until you click Save.
PLAYER-FOLDERS.clear-all-confirm: Clear every folder in this dialog? Nothing is saved until you click Save.
PLAYER-FOLDERS.search-hint: Uncheck to add additional folders for GMs only, including S3 buckets.
PLAYER-FOLDERS.kind-pc-token-hint: Token and prototype token image selection for player characters
PLAYER-FOLDERS.kind-other-token-hint: Token and prototype token image selection for every other actor type
PLAYER-FOLDERS.kind-image-hint: Sheet image selection when clicking a sheet's portrait or the image on an item sheet
PLAYER-FOLDERS.kind-header-hint: Themed sheet header backgrounds in Tidy's Theme Settings
TOKEN-HUD.name: Token HUD
TOKEN-HUD.label: Configure Token HUD
TOKEN-HUD.hint: How the token, tile and drawing HUDs scale with zoom, and the GM hover shortcut. The GM sets these for everyone; players can change the size settings for their own screen.
TOKEN-HUD.players-off: The GM has turned the Token HUD improvements off.
TOKEN-HUD.enabled-hint: Turns on everything below: zoom scaling, menus that stay on screen (and optionally open on hover), and the GM hover shortcut. Reloads when changed.
TOKEN-HUD.button-scale-hint: Size of the HUD buttons relative to Foundry's default.
TOKEN-HUD.zoom-response-hint: Keep some scaling while zooming. 100% = Maintain a consistent size, 0% = Foundry's default that doesn't scale with zoom. Default is 70%.
TOKEN-HUD.min-size-hint: Smallest size the HUD can shrink to when zoomed out, as a % of its full size. Default is 85%.
TOKEN-HUD.one-by-one-hint: Uses a 1x1 token size as the baseline for the HUD instead of the full token size. Mostly makes it easier to use with large tokens.
TOKEN-HUD.hover-menus-hint: Resting the pointer on a HUD menu button (such as status effects) opens its menu after half a second. Off means menus open on click, as in Foundry's default.
TOKEN-HUD.focus-hp-name: Focus HP on Token Right Click
TOKEN-HUD.focus-hp-hint: When the HUD opens, put the cursor in the HP box with its value selected so you can type a new number right away. The GM hover HP tab does this whether or not this is on.
TOKEN-HUD.hover-shortcut-hint: When the GM hovers a token, a small HP tab shows at its bottom right corner. Clicking it opens the full HUD. Has no effect for players.
TOKEN-HUD.conflict-custom-dnd5e: DMM Token HUD is off because Custom D&D 5e's Token HUD Improvements is also on. Turn it off in Game Settings → Configure Settings → Custom D&D 5e → Configure Interface → Token HUD Improvements, then reload.
TOKEN-HUD.conflict-illandril: DMM Token HUD is off because Illandril's Token HUD Scale is also active. Disable it in Game Settings → Manage Modules, then reload.
